purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find the inspector's observation about the garage wall.
activities.modelFrench: L’inspecteur : « Près du mur du garage, je constate un manque de solin à gradins sur deux rangs. »
activities.modelEnglish: Inspector: On the garage wall the step flashing is missing on two courses.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the re-inspection in French.
Listen and identify the French term for building permit.
Type 'Could you tell me what needs to be corrected?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Pourriez-vous préciser par écrit ce qui doit être corrigé ?
activities.modelEnglish: Could you tell me what needs to be corrected?

activities.cueEnglish: Show the inspector the permit and greet him.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio est descendu du toit pour l’accueillir : « Bonjour, voici le permis. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio came down from the roof and greeted him: Good morning, here's the permit.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Rogelio says about arranging a correction and re-inspection.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Nous organiserons la correction puis demanderons une nouvelle inspection selon la procédure locale. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: We'll arrange the correction and request re-inspection under the local process.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what the report says was completed on the east side.
activities.modelFrench: Résumé : selon le relevé, quatorze carrés ont été réalisés du côté est; de plus, la noue principale a été traitée.
activities.modelEnglish: Summary: according to the measurement, 14 squares were completed on the east side; the main valley was also treated.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the daily report in French.
Listen and identify the French term for deck repair.
Type 'Before and after photos are attached.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Les photos avant et après sont jointes.
activities.modelEnglish: Before and after photos are attached.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask Kevin to send the plywood photos.
activities.modelFrench: Il a d’abord écrit à Kevin : « Envoie-moi les photos du contreplaqué, s’il te plaît. »
activities.modelEnglish: First he sent Kevin a message: Hey, send me the photos of the plywood.

activities.cueEnglish: Write the open items from the report.
activities.modelFrench: Points ouverts : la finition du faîtage ouest et le nettoyage de la gouttière restent à faire.
activities.modelEnglish: Open items: the ridge cap on the west side is still pending and, in addition, the gutter still needs cleaning.

activities.cueEnglish: Find why the crew cannot start at Mrs. Kim's house tomorrow.
activities.modelFrench: Message : « À cause de la pluie, nous ne pourrons pas commencer demain; serait-il possible de reporter à jeudi ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Message: Due to the rain delay, we won't be able to start tomorrow; would it be possible to start on Thursday?

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the voicemail in French.
Listen and identify the French term for rain delay.
activities.modelFrench: le retard dû à la pluie

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Would it be possible to start on Thursday?' in French.
activities.modelEnglish: Would it be possible to start on Thursday?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask Mr. Kim whether Friday works for him.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Je comprends. Seriez-vous disponibles vendredi, sous réserve de la météo ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: I understand. Would you be available Friday, weather permitting?

activities.cueEnglish: Write the Friday arrival time proposed in the final text.
activities.modelFrench: Le soir, Rogelio a écrit : « Je propose vendredi à 8 h; merci de confirmer. Je vous préviendrai si l’horaire ou la livraison change. »
activities.modelEnglish: That night Rogelio wrote: I propose Friday at 8:00 a.m.; please confirm. I'll let you know if the time or delivery changes.
